items.title: Alan Broadbent interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 26, 2023
items.q: if you want Earl Hines and Nat Cole, Bud even sits at the piano kind of like Nat Cole.

ctx.x: I want to pursue that for a moment. The feeling, ‘cause I think I know what you mean, is it about swing?

It’s a deep swing. It’s a very deep relationship. I’ll give you the people, well the man that invented it was Louis Armstrong of course. You can hear that in his — well there’s YouTube of him doing “Dinah” with his group somewhere in Copenhagen or something. And his — you know his group is chugging along [scats] but Louis, when he starts to impro— even with a few notes — where he puts those notes are, they’re like, I don’t know, a tension-release thing you know when his more complicated phrases happen they still…
Well said. Nice quote. The person that you mentioned — we had a slight cutoff in the connection — and you said this quote from someone.
